name: lightsmith-circuit
citation: S-matrix interconnection S_ee + S_ei C (I - S_ii C)^-1 S_ie; pairwise reduction as scikit-rf's innerconnect (Arsenovic et al., IEEE Microwave Magazine 23, 98 (2022))

algorithm.description: dense: one batched (I - S C) solve; reduce: pairwise sub-circuit reduction (better for very large netlists); auto picks by size.
algorithm.title: Algorithm

unconnected.description: Ports that are neither connected nor external: error, or treat as matched ends.
unconnected.title: Unconnected

base_dir.description: Directory that relative 'sparams:<path>' files are read from.
base_dir.title: Base Dir

passivity_tol.description: Warn when the largest singular value of S exceeds 1 + tol.
passivity_tol.title: Passivity Tol

name: lightsmith-dda
citation: Draine & Flatau, JOSA A 11, 1491 (1994); Goodman, Draine & Flatau, Opt. Lett. 16, 1198 (1991)

dipoles_per_diameter.description: Lattice sites across the smallest particle's largest dimension. Default: max(16, enough for |m| k d <= 0.5).
dipoles_per_diameter.title: Dipoles Per Diameter

discretization.description: center: classic staircase with volume rescaling. weighted (experimental): boundary sites mix full-site polarizabilities by volume fraction.
discretization.title: Discretization

precision.description: auto = double on CPU, single on GPU.
precision.title: Precision

tol.description: Relative residual target. Default 1e-8 double, 1e-5 single.
tol.title: Tol

extrapolate.description: dipoles_per_diameter values to extrapolate to zero dipole size, e.g. [12, 16, 24]. Quadratic in 1/npd for 3+ values, linear for 2. Experimental: staircase noise makes it unreliable for metal spheres.
extrapolate.title: Extrapolate

name: lightsmith-eme
citation: Bienstman & Baets, Opt. Quantum Electron. 33, 327 (2001); Gallagher & Felici, Proc. SPIE 4987 (2003)

num_modes.description: Modes per cell. Default 30 in 2D, 10 in 3D.
num_modes.title: Num Modes

grid_spacing_nm.description: Cross-section grid step. Default from points_per_wavelength and cells_per_feature.
grid_spacing_nm.title: Grid Spacing Nm

boundary.description: Cross-section walls (PEC box modes, or PML).
boundary.title: Boundary

polarization.description: auto: 'te' (in-plane E) in 2D, 'any' in 3D. In 3D, 'te'/'tm' filter by te_fraction (inexact: the basis loses completeness).
polarization.title: Polarization

taper_cells.description: Cells per continuously varying segment (tapers, curves). Default: enough for the outline to move ~3 grid cells per step, clipped to 10-60.
taper_cells.title: Taper Cells

max_cell_length_nm.description: Also split segments longer than this.
max_cell_length_nm.title: Max Cell Length Nm

cache.description: Reuse cell modes across solves (byte-limited LRU, 256 MB).
cache.title: Cache

name: lightsmith-fde
citation: Zhu & Brown, Opt. Express 10, 853 (2002); Fallahkhair, Li & Murphy, J. Lightwave Technol. 26, 1423 (2008)

grid_spacing_nm.description: Grid step (x, y). Default: points_per_wavelength in the densest material and cells_per_feature across the smallest structure.
grid_spacing_nm.title: Grid Spacing Nm

subpixel.description: anisotropic: harmonic mean along each E component, arithmetic across (best for interfaces); volume: fill-fraction average; none: staircase.
subpixel.title: Subpixel

subsamples.description: Samples per axis in cells cut by an interface (16x as many along x for slabs).
subsamples.title: Subsamples

boundary.description: auto = PML for bends, PEC otherwise.
boundary.title: Boundary

pml_reflection.description: Normal-incidence reflection the PML grading targets.
pml_reflection.title: Pml Reflection

symmetry.description: Mirror planes x = window centre and y = window centre. 'pec' zeroes tangential E on the plane (e.g. x-plane for TE0 of a strip, whose Ex is even), 'pmc' zeroes tangential H.
symmetry.title: Symmetry

polarization.description: Keep only modes with te_fraction > 0.5 ('te', dominant Ex) or < 0.5 ('tm').
polarization.title: Polarization

group_index.description: auto: perturbation formula without PML, wavelength finite difference with PML.
group_index.title: Group Index

track_modes.description: Order modes at each wavelength by overlap with the previous wavelength instead of by neff.
track_modes.title: Track Modes

bend_reference_x_nm.description: x where the bend radius is measured (centre of curvature at this x minus R). Default: the window centre.
bend_reference_x_nm.title: Bend Reference X Nm

name: lightsmith-fdfd
citation: Shin & Fan, J. Comput. Phys. 231, 3406 (2012); Hughes et al., ACS Photonics 6, 3010 (2019)

polarization.description: 2D polarization: 'te' = E in the xy plane (Hz), the usual choice for planar photonics; 'tm' = E along z (Ez).
polarization.title: Polarization

dl_nm.description: Grid cell size. Default: shortest wavelength / (cells_per_wavelength * highest refractive index).
dl_nm.title: Dl Nm

cells_per_wavelength.description: Cells per wavelength in the densest material.
cells_per_wavelength.title: Cells Per Wavelength

pml_cells.description: PML thickness in cells, added outside the domain; a pair gives (x, y). 0 = PEC/PMC wall on that axis.
pml_cells.title: Pml Cells

solver.description: auto = SciPy SuperLU on CPU, torch block-tridiagonal LU on GPU.
solver.title: Solver

subsamples.description: Supersampling per axis for subpixel permittivity.
subsamples.title: Subsamples

name: lightsmith-inverse
citation: Hammond et al., Opt. Express 29, 23916 (2021); Svanberg, SIAM J. Optim. 12, 555 (2002); Molesky et al., Nat. Photonics 12, 659 (2018)

name: lightsmith-fdtd
citation: Taflove & Hagness, Computational Electrodynamics (2005); Roden & Gedney, MOTL 27, 334 (2000); Oskooi et al., CPC 181, 687 (2010)

spacing_nm.description: Yee cell size. Overrides cells_per_wavelength and cells_per_radius.
spacing_nm.title: Spacing Nm

cells_per_wavelength.description: Cells per shortest wavelength inside the optically densest material (|n|).
cells_per_wavelength.title: Cells Per Wavelength

cells_per_radius.description: Minimum cells across the smallest particle half-extent. Default 10, or 20 when a material has Re(eps) < 0 in the band (plasmonic; ~10% peak-height error at 20).
cells_per_radius.title: Cells Per Radius

pml_kappa.description: CPML kappa_max (>1 damps evanescent fields faster).
pml_kappa.title: Pml Kappa

padding_nm.description: Gap between the particles' bounding box (periodic: the stack) and the TFSF box (plane). Default 4 cells.
padding_nm.title: Padding Nm

pml_gap_nm.description: Gap between the flux monitors and the CPML. Default 4 cells (scattering); periodic: 3 decay lengths of the slowest evanescent diffraction order, 0.25-1.5 wavelengths.
pml_gap_nm.title: Pml Gap Nm

courant.description: Time step as a fraction of the 3D Courant limit.
courant.title: Courant

run_time_fs.description: Fixed simulated time in fs. Disables the decay shutoff.
run_time_fs.title: Run Time Fs

decay_by.description: Stop when the field energy on the flux monitors has fallen below this fraction of its peak (after the pulse has passed).
decay_by.title: Decay By

max_time_fs.description: Hard cap on simulated time in fs (high-Q resonances need ps).
max_time_fs.title: Max Time Fs

precision.description: auto = single on GPU, double on CPU.
precision.title: Precision

subpixel.description: Anisotropic subpixel smoothing at interfaces (dispersive too).
subpixel.title: Subpixel

subpixel_samples.description: Supersamples per axis for interface cells.
subpixel_samples.title: Subpixel Samples

dft_stride.description: Time steps between DFT samples. Default: from the source bandwidth (aliasing-safe).
dft_stride.title: Dft Stride

cuda_graphs.description: Replay time steps as CUDA graphs on PyTorch CUDA (much faster).
cuda_graphs.title: Cuda Graphs

name: lightsmith-mie
citation: Bohren & Huffman (1983); Yang, Appl. Opt. 42, 1710 (2003); Pena & Pal, Comput. Phys. Commun. 180, 2348 (2009)

precision.description: Floating-point precision of the series. 'single' is typically ~1e-7 relative but degrades to ~1e-3 near zeros of psi_n(x); the series is memory-bound, so on GPUs it is no faster than double. Near fields always use double.
precision.title: Precision

n_max.description: Number of multipole orders. Default: Wiscombe's rule (homogeneous) or Pena & Pal's (layered), per wavelength chunk.
n_max.title: N Max

wavelength_chunk.description: Wavelengths per vectorised batch. Default: as many as fit in ~1 GiB of work arrays.
wavelength_chunk.title: Wavelength Chunk

name: lightsmith-pwe
citation: Ho, Chan & Soukoulis, PRL 65, 3152 (1990); Johnson & Joannopoulos, Opt. Express 8, 173 (2001); Farjadpour et al., Opt. Lett. 31, 2972 (2006)

solver.description: dense: Ho-Chan-Soukoulis matrices + batched eigh. lobpcg: matrix-free FFT operators with subpixel-smoothed eps. auto: dense for TM (matrix <= 2500), lobpcg for TE and 3D; setting only num_plane_waves forces dense, setting only resolution forces lobpcg.
solver.title: Solver

num_plane_waves.description: Dense basis size (completed to a full |G| shell). Default 400 (2D) / 600 (3D) per unit-cell area/volume in a^d.
num_plane_waves.title: Num Plane Waves

resolution.description: lobpcg grid points per lattice constant a (default 32 in 2D, 16 in 3D).
resolution.title: Resolution

eps_fourier.description: Dense eps_hat: analytic shape transforms (needs non-overlapping inclusions) or a supersampled raster. auto = analytic when valid.
eps_fourier.title: Eps Fourier

subsamples.description: Raster supersampling per axis (default 4 in 2D, 2 in 3D).
subsamples.title: Subsamples

reference_wavelength_nm.description: Vacuum wavelength at which materials are evaluated. Needed for dispersive materials (default 2a, i.e. a/lambda = 0.5, with a warning).
reference_wavelength_nm.title: Reference Wavelength Nm

precision.description: auto = double, except single for the dense solver on a GPU (~1e-5 in a/lambda).
precision.title: Precision

name: lightsmith-quasistatic
citation: Bohren & Huffman, Absorption and Scattering of Light by Small Particles (1983), ch. 5; Meier & Wokaun, Opt. Lett. 8, 581 (1983)

corrections.description: none: static dipole. radiative: add radiative damping. mlwa: modified long-wavelength approximation (dynamic depolarisation + radiative damping). mie_dipole: Mie dipole term exact to O(x^4) + radiative damping (homogeneous spheres only).
corrections.title: Corrections

name: lightsmith-rcwa
citation: Moharam et al., JOSA A 12, 1068 (1995); Li, JOSA A 13, 1870 (1996) and JOSA A 14, 2758 (1997); Schuster et al., JOSA A 24, 2880 (2007); Rumpf, PIER B 35, 241 (2011)

harmonics.description: Highest diffraction order kept along each lattice direction (|m| <= M, |n| <= N); an int applies to both. Default 25 for 1D gratings, 7 per direction for 2D lattices.
harmonics.title: Harmonics

factorization.description: auto/li/normal_vector: Li's inverse rule for 1D gratings and the normal-vector-field method for 2D lattices (needed for metals); laurent: naive Laurent rule everywhere.
factorization.title: Factorization

fourier.description: 2D eps Fourier coefficients: closed-form shape transforms (auto, when shapes do not overlap) or a supersampled raster.
fourier.title: Fourier

raster_points.description: Raster grid points per lattice direction.
raster_points.title: Raster Points

normal_blur.description: Gaussian smoothing of the 2D normal-vector field, as a fraction of the shortest lattice vector.
normal_blur.title: Normal Blur

max_batch_bytes.description: Wavelengths are solved in batches using about this much memory.
max_batch_bytes.title: Max Batch Bytes

name: treams
citation: Beutel, Fernandez-Corbaton & Rockstuhl, Comput. Phys. Commun. 297, 109076 (2024); treams, https://github.com/tfp-photonics/treams

lmax.description: Multipole order of every particle's T-matrix. Default: Wiscombe's criterion at the shortest wavelength, plus extra orders for particles with close neighbours.
lmax.title: Lmax

extra_orders.description: Orders added to the automatic per-particle lmax.
extra_orders.title: Extra Orders

lmax_global.description: Order of the cluster's global T-matrix, used for orientation_average. Default: Wiscombe's criterion on the circumscribing sphere, plus 2.
lmax_global.title: Lmax Global

convergence_check.description: For clusters, re-solve the wavelength of peak extinction with lmax + 2 and warn if the cross sections move by more than convergence_tol.
convergence_check.title: Convergence Check

convergence_tol.description: Relative tolerance of the convergence check.
convergence_tol.title: Convergence Tol

max_modes.description: Refuse clusters whose T-matrix has more modes than this (dense, so memory grows as modes^2).
max_modes.title: Max Modes

name: lightsmith-tmm
citation: Born & Wolf, Principles of Optics, Sec. 1.6; Katsidis & Siapkas, Appl. Opt. 41, 3978 (2002); Byrnes, arXiv:1603.02720

precision.description: auto = double (TMM is cheap; interference needs the digits).
precision.title: Precision
